// Baseline capture: contract events, durable state and a permission-guarded entrypoint.
seiyaku BaselineEvents {
  permission Writer;
  state StateMap<int,bool> Values;
  event Saved { bool value; }
  kotoage fn main() authorize(anyone) -> bool {
    emit Saved { value: true };
    return true;
  }
  kotoage fn save(bool succeed) authorize(Writer) -> Result<bool,int> {
    Values[1] = true;
    emit Saved { value: succeed };
    if succeed { return Result::ok(true); }
    return Result::err(7);
  }
}
